text:
Anya: quick heads-up — we discovered intermittent NVLink resets on a subset of az14 racks after the latest vendor BIOS. vendor recommends BMC+NVLink microcode reboot to stabilize telemetry.
Samir: timeline? impact? :eyes:
Anya: proposed window: Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC, staggered 15m cohort reboots across the pool (cohort size ~8 nodes). expecting short kernel reconnects and transient gRPC errors for active sessions.
Leo: how much capacity will be offline at peak? any Dedicated customers in that pool?
Anya: peak offline ~8 nodes per cohort. Dedicated reservations: 2 small reserved pools pinned to az14 — we can migrate those routes to az12 as a failover, but will add cross-region latency for some tenants.
Maria: migration plan and customer comms? we should offer to credit any sustained errors during the window.
Samir: agree on credits for affected Dedicated customers. ops: can we backfill with spot/ephemeral capacity first to reduce user impact?
Anya: yes — backfill policy: drain -> mark drain priority -> re-route new requests to az12/az13 -> spin ephemeral on az12 until cohort finishes. backfill should keep token-per-second within SLO for most routes.
ops-bot: scheduled_maintenance: az14 cohort-0: 2026-04-08T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-08T02:15:00Z
Leo: need a canary beforehand to validate NVLink state. suggest one rack at 01:30 UTC, and run smoke load (short generation + embedding queries).
Anya: canary timed for 01:30, running smoke script:
```
# smoke test
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"smoke test"}'; done
```
Samir: who owns rollbacks if canary fails? we should abort and notify CS + infra-runbook.
Maria: I’ll draft a short customer note for CS: what to expect, ETA, fallback, and credit policy. keep it <200 words.
Anya: routing tweaks: add temporary route policy to prefer az12 for model routes pinned to az14. releasing after cohort completes.
Leo: watch list: KV cache warmup for pinned sessions, watch token latency and cache-miss ratios. set alert if 95p latency > 350ms for >2m.
ops-bot: alert_rule_created: infra/az14/latency-95p -> threshold 350ms -> notify #eng-oncall
Samir: cost note — backfilling with ephemeral az12 will add ~0.8x unit cost for the 2-hour window. Finance, we’ll file the usage spike under "maintenance backfill" for chargeback.
Maria: drafting email now, will post to #customer-success for review in 10m.
Anya: final checklist: canary 01:30, cohort1 02:00, cohort2 02:15, cohort3 02:30, rollback abort path documented. tagging oncall when canary starts. any objections?
Leo: none from me, just make sure we have NVLink logs and vendor support channel up in parallel.
Samir: 👍 I'll coordinate vendor on standby and sign off on credits if we see any sustained errors.
Anya: thanks — will post updates here during the window. :shipit:
